reviews.text: Amazing experience and atmosphere. My husband has gone here twice to get his hair cut and it was amazing (fade). Today we also brought our squirmy 2 year old and he was handled so well (lots of toys and things for him to do, lots of patience and understanding). Both their hair cuts were 10/10 once again. We will be coming here for hair cuts for the foreseeable future!! Thank you!!!

reviews.author: A. T.
reviews.text: Went to Def Cutz looking for a last-minute haircut, and the whole experience was extremely painless. Online booking the day before was easy with a convenient timeslot (it’s great to be able to get a haircut at 8pm after work). Very fair price and a great hair and beard cut. I enjoyed the chat; Patrick is very friendly and grounded—and I don’t usually like talking at the barber. Thank you, Patrick, for making it a nice experience. I’ll be back! :)
